# OriginsMeta

> Unofficial companion site for Origins TCG, the digital trading card game by Koin Games: news, tier list, win-rate analytics, guides, the full card database, community decks, a deck builder and a draft, a match tracker app for Windows and a tournament calendar, in English, Italian, Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese, German and Russian.

OriginsMeta is a fan project run by players and is not affiliated with Koin Games. For rules, dates and announcements the official sources always win; everything here is sourced from them and says so on the page.

Origins TCG is a digital trading card game by Koin Games, a studio based in Tampa, Florida, founded in 2021. Its cast is made of public-domain legends — Robin Hood, Mulan, the Queen of Hearts, Dracula and many more — reimagined in one original world. The game is presented as free-to-compete: every card needed to play competitively is earned by playing, and money only buys collectible versions of cards. It has been free to play on Steam in Early Access since 27 October 2026 (version 0.8, the update that ended the demo); Koin Games aims for version 1.0 around March 2027 (17 March 2027 on the Steam page, an indicative date that may change).

Card data on this site follows the latest published patch — at the time of writing, patch 0.7 of 29 September 2026, with all 122 cards of the game's collection checked one by one in the game on 22 September 2026, before that patch; the demo update 0.7.1 of 15 October 2026 and the Early Access update 0.8 of 27 October 2026 list no card changes — and is updated when a new patch changes it, so stats and card text move with the game rather than staying fixed at one version. Every page states the patch its numbers come from.

Community decks are written by players in their own language; the site translates each deck guide automatically into the other three languages and says so on the translated page, with a link to the author's original.

## Key facts (checked on 25 September 2026; updated for Early Access on 28 October 2026)

- Release: Origins TCG has been in Early Access on Steam since 27 October 2026, free to play, with version 0.8 (Steam post "Goodbye Demo, Welcome Early Access"). Koin Games aims to leave Early Access with version 1.0 around 17 March 2027, a date the Steam page gives as indicative and subject to change; the same page says the game will stay free-to-play and free-to-compete during Early Access and after, and that Early Access will feature some premium paid features (read on 28 October 2026).
- Early Access: version 0.8 of 27 October 2026 ended the demo and moved accounts, collections and progress to the Early Access version. It opened the Grandmaster Division with a world leaderboard (the first ranked season of Early Access should end in early December, with limited-edition rewards for the highest ranks: Koin's plan, which may change), shows the grade from 1 to 10 on collectible cards, and lets players buy and sell collectible cards on the Steam Community Market; its patch notes list no card changes. Before that, the free demo was on Steam from 15 July to 27 October 2026: its first big update arrived on 21 September 2026, patch 0.7 of 29 September 2026 was the last balance patch before the Crimson Cup, and update 0.7.1 of 15 October 2026 opened ranked mode, four days before Steam Next Fest ([demo 0.7.1 notes](https://originsmeta.com/en/news/demo-patch-notes-0-7-1)). Guide: [How to download and play Origins TCG](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/play-the-demo).
- Crimson Cup: the official tournament of the Next Fest, held from 19 to 25 October 2026 (five qualifiers from the 19th to the 22nd, playoffs on the 24th, finals on the 25th) on the demo, and won by CoachCrono on 25 October 2026 ([CoachCrono wins the Crimson Cup](https://originsmeta.com/en/news/crimson-cup-coachcrono-wins)). The format was three-deck Conquest with at least 8 unique cards between each pair of decks, with decklists hidden until the top 4. Summary in the next section; rules: [Crimson Cup format and check-in](https://originsmeta.com/en/news/crimson-cup-format-check-in).
- Kickstarter: open since 27 October 2026 (Steam post "The Origins Kickstarter is LIVE"), for the Alpha Set "Myths & Legends", a Kickstarter exclusive of 218 cards that Koin says it will release gradually throughout Early Access. The date had been announced by Koin Games' CEO Tim Jooste on X on 17 September 2026 ("back the Alpha Edition Kickstarter (Oct 27th)"), and the demo's main menu showed it as "Coming soon – Oct 27". Guide: [Origins TCG Kickstarter](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/origins-tcg-kickstarter).
- Languages: since patch 0.7 of 29 September 2026 the game supports 13 languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese (Brazil), Portuguese (Portugal), Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian and Simplified Chinese (official patch notes). The Steam page lists the same 13 for the interface, with full audio in English only (read on 30 September, 18 October and 28 October 2026).
- Platforms: the Steam page lists Windows and macOS (read on 28 October 2026). Mobile is not out: on its pre-registration page (founder.origins-tcg.com) Koin Games writes "Mobile pack opening is coming! We have our sights set on 2027 for Origins on Mobile." (read on 25 September 2026). Neither page says whether that means Android, iOS or both.
- Progress from the demo: the demo ended on 27 October 2026, and Koin Games' Steam post says that accounts, collections, progression and everything else now live in the Early Access version; on the official Discord, Koin's Studio Head added that all progress was transferred and that the demo can be uninstalled.
- Not Riftbound: "Riftbound Origins" is a card set of Riftbound, the League of Legends trading card game (official Riftbound site, read on 25 September 2026). Origins TCG by Koin Games is a different game.
- Deck rules: one Legendary plus twelve different base cards, two copies each, for 25 cards. Deck codes of the game start with KGBLDC: the deck builder imports them and exports them.
- Answers to the most common questions, each with its source and date: [FAQ](https://originsmeta.com/en/faq).
- Dates and roadmap: [Roadmap and dates](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/roadmap-and-dates). Next Fest: [Steam Next Fest 2026 guide](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/steam-next-fest-2026).

## Crimson Cup rules in brief

The official Origins TCG tournament of Steam Next Fest, run by Koin Games (announcements of 9 and 24 September and 5 October 2026) and won by CoachCrono on 25 October 2026. The rules as they were announced; full rules and times: [Crimson Cup rules](https://originsmeta.com/en/news/crimson-cup-format-check-in).

- When and where: 19–25 October 2026, entirely online and in the game, on the main demo of the time (not on the playtest). Five qualifiers of 512 spots each, 32 advancing from each: AMER on 19 October at 7pm EST, EMEA on 20 October at 7pm CEST, AMER on 21 October at 9pm EST, APAC on 22 October at 7pm SGT, EMEA on 22 October at 7pm CEST, plus 96 wild cards; players can join any qualifier, wherever they live. Playoffs on 24 October at 10am EST (256 spots), finals on 25 October at 10am EST.
- Locations: seven are out of the tournament pool because they depend too much on luck (Junkyard, Cloning Lab, Reflecting Pool, Amplifying Amphitheatre, Giant's Beacon, The Colosseum, Nostradamus' Call); room battles in the demo used the same pool.
- Format: Conquest with three decks, with at least 8 unique cards between each pair of decks. The announcements do not say whether the three Legendaries must differ (at Big Bob's Playtest Battle in August they had to). Decklists stay hidden until the top 4: in the ban you only see the Legendary.
- Matches: best of three, with a best-of-five grand final (announcement of 9 September). Best-of-five matches have no ban: you must win with all three decks.
- Check-in: opens two hours before each qualifier and closes five minutes before the start, together with deck submission. Miss it and you can't play.
- Prizes: worth $10,000 in total, split between cash, collectibles and exclusive promo cards (breakdown of 5 October 2026): the winner gets a 1/1 Dracula promo card, two booster box cases and $1,500; 2nd a 1/8 Dracula promo card, one case and $750; 3rd and 4th a 1/8 promo card, two booster boxes and $350; top 8 a booster box, a 1/8 promo card and $125; top 16 a booster box and a Finalist Plus card; top 32 ten packs and a Finalist card; top 64, 128 and 256 get 8, 4 and 2 packs. Details: [Crimson Cup prize pool and new qualifiers](https://originsmeta.com/en/news/crimson-cup-prizepool-qualifiers).
- Balance: patch 0.7 of 29 September 2026 is, in the team's words, the final balance patch before the tournament: Twister Toss reworked, Bagheera, Mind Palace and Spellbook 1 mana more ([patch 0.7 notes](https://originsmeta.com/en/news/patch-0-7)).
- Sign-ups were on the [official Discord](https://discord.gg/originstcg), where Koin also announced weekly no-stakes practice tournaments. Guide to the festival: [Origins TCG at Steam Next Fest 2026](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/steam-next-fest-2026). The [deck builder](https://originsmeta.com/en/deck-builder) has a tournament mode that checks three decks against the Conquest rule.

## Legendaries

The 11 Legendaries in the game: every deck is led by one of them. Data of the latest patch (patch 0.7 of 29 September 2026); the 0.8 patch notes of 27 October 2026, the first version of Early Access, list no card changes. Each card page is also in Italian (/it/cards/…), Spanish (/es/cards/…), French (/fr/cards/…), Brazilian Portuguese (/pt/cards/…), German (/de/cards/…) and Russian (/ru/cards/…) with the same slug, the official text of the game in Italian, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German and Russian, and the balance history.

- [Dorothy](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/dorothy): Legendary unit, 4 mana, 1 Power / 1 Health, Good. I can Move each round. I have +1 Power/+1 Health for each time an ally moved this game.
- [Dracula](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/dracula): Legendary unit, 4 mana, 3 Power / 2 Health, Evil. When you discard, return me from your graveyard to hand. On Reveal: Summon Brides of Dracula [2 Power/2 Health] on a random space here.
- [King Arthur](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/king-arthur): Legendary unit, 7 mana, 7 Power / 7 Health, Good. Shield. On Reveal: Give your Good characters Shield.
- [Legion of the Dead](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/legion-of-the-dead): Legendary spell, 7 mana, Neutral. Fill your board with Zombies [2 Power/2 Health].
- [Merlin](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/merlin): Legendary unit, 5 mana, 5 Power / 5 Health, Neutral. Repeat the first spell you play each round.
- [Mulan](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/mulan): Legendary unit, 4 mana, 2 Power / 4 Health, Good. Double Attack. When an ally On Reveal ability happens, repeat it.
- [Queen of Hearts](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/queen-of-hearts): Legendary unit, 4 mana, 3 Power / 3 Health, Evil. First Strike. When an ally On Death ability happens, repeat it.
- [Robin Hood](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/robin-hood): Legendary unit, 8 mana, 4 Power / 4 Health, Good. Snipe 3. On Reveal: Deal 2 damage to all enemies.
- [Three Not So Little Pigs](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/three-not-so-little-pigs): Legendary unit, 7 mana, 3 Power / 3 Health, Neutral. Trample. On Reveal: Summon a Not So Little Pig [3 Power/3 Health] with Trample on a random space at each other location.
- [Van Helsing](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/van-helsing): Legendary unit, 4 mana, 3 Power / 4 Health, Good. Before combat, add Van Helsing's Tools to your hand if it is not already there.
- [Wicked Stepmother](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards/wicked-stepmother): Legendary unit, 4 mana, 4 Power / 6 Health, Evil. Deathtouch. On Reveal: Give your Evil characters Deathtouch.

## English pages

- [Home](https://originsmeta.com/en): what is new across the site — news, calendar, tier list and MetaShifting.
- [FAQ](https://originsmeta.com/en/faq): the answers we have written and checked, each with its source and date: release date and Early Access, languages, mobile, progress from the demo, ranked mode, the Legendaries, deck codes, the Crimson Cup and the Kickstarter.
- [Tier list](https://originsmeta.com/en/tier-list): decks, Legendaries and base cards; the OriginsMeta ranking, built on tournament results, is in preparation.
- [Most played](https://originsmeta.com/en/tier-list/most-played): how many of the decks published on OriginsMeta use each Legendary and card, with the deck archetypes. Popularity, not a win rate.
- [Community tier list](https://originsmeta.com/en/tier-list/community): the average of the tier lists saved by members, with votes per card; a preview until 5 lists.
- [Tier list maker](https://originsmeta.com/en/tier-list/create): make your own Origins TCG tier list by dragging the game's cards into tiers S to D, with the Legendaries on their own list, and share it with a link. Free, no account needed.
- [Card votes tier list](https://originsmeta.com/en/tier-list/votes): rate every Origins TCG card from 1 (weak) to 10 (excellent); the average of the members' votes builds a tier list of Legendaries and base cards.
- [MetaShifting](https://originsmeta.com/en/metashifting): Origins TCG patch notes: every balance change, card by card and patch by patch, newest first, taken from Koin Games' official posts.
- [Card list](https://originsmeta.com/en/cards): every card in the game with current stats, the official text in English, Italian, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German and Russian as it reads in the game, balance history and the legend it comes from.
- [Locations](https://originsmeta.com/en/locations): the locations recorded so far, with their effects, searchable and filterable.
- [Decks](https://originsmeta.com/en/decks): deck lists published by the community from the deck builder, each with a guide and 1–5 star ratings. At the top, the [best Origins TCG decks right now](https://originsmeta.com/en/decks#best-decks): the community ranking by weighted rating, not a win rate.
- [Tournament decks](https://originsmeta.com/en/decks/tournament): three-deck Conquest line-ups for tournaments like the Crimson Cup, published by players with one guide: three different Legendaries, game codes and votes.
- [Draft](https://originsmeta.com/en/draft): a free Origins TCG draft in three formats against the Brain, our bot, or against a friend: pick your cards, build one Legendary plus twelve and copy the game code.
- [Analytics](https://originsmeta.com/en/analytics): Origins TCG win rates from the matches recorded with the OriginsMeta Tracker app: Legendaries, community decks, archetypes, cards and matchups, patch by patch.
- [Crimson Cup numbers](https://originsmeta.com/en/analytics/crimson-cup): Koin Games' official Crimson Cup numbers, qualifier by qualifier: ban rate of every Legendary, decks submitted, the most played cards and the tournament next to the ladder.
- [OriginsMeta Tracker](https://originsmeta.com/en/tracker): our Windows app that records your Origins TCG matches on its own, tracks your deck next to the game and adds an overlay for streamers; it works with a free OriginsMeta account. Step-by-step install guide.
- [Deck builder](https://originsmeta.com/en/deck-builder): build a legal deck in the browser — one Legendary plus twelve different base cards in two copies each, 25 cards — then export the game code or publish the list. Free, no account needed to build.
- [Guides](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides): how the game works, the roadmap, the collector economy, how to start playing, deck guides and matchups.
- [Tournaments and events](https://originsmeta.com/en/tournaments): official and community events, plus the community tournament organizer.
- [News](https://originsmeta.com/en/news): official announcements, game updates, events and the decks published on the site; every patch also has its own article. Every item has its own signed article page, with the date, the official source and the cards it touches.
- [Who writes here](https://originsmeta.com/en/authors): the people who sign the guides, the decks and the news, and what each of them covers.
- [Community guides](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/community): guides written by the Authors, Creators and Pro players of OriginsMeta, kept up to date by their authors and translated by the site.
- [Comics](https://originsmeta.com/en/news/comics): comics about Origins TCG drawn by the community's creators.
- [Creators and authors](https://originsmeta.com/en/creators): the creators, authors and streamers who make Origins TCG content, with their channels and languages.
- [About](https://originsmeta.com/en/about): who we are, how we work and which sources we use.

## Guides

Every OriginsMeta guide in English, the game first and then the deck guides; each one is also in Italian (/it/guides/…), Spanish (/es/guides/…), French (/fr/guides/…), Brazilian Portuguese (/pt/guides/…), German (/de/guides/…) and Russian (/ru/guides/…) with the same slug.

- [The 11 Legendaries of Origins TCG: cards, stats, patches and decks](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/origins-tcg-legendaries): All 11 playable Legendary cards of Origins TCG: cost, stats, official text, the cards they create, patch changes and the decks that use them.
- [Origins TCG locations: how the three lanes change every game](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/origins-tcg-locations): Locations are the third player at the table: they double damage, change costs and move your characters. How they work, which ones decide games, and how to build with them in mind.
- [How to download and play Origins TCG free on Steam](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/play-the-demo): Play Origins TCG free on Steam in Early Access: requirements, download, language, first matches, what update 0.8 brings and what became of the demo.
- [Origins TCG explained in five minutes](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/origins-tcg-explained): What Origins TCG is, how a match works across three lanes with simultaneous turns, what free-to-compete means and how to play it free on Steam today.
- [Streaming Origins TCG: OBS overlay and !deck chat command](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/streaming-tools): Free tools for Origins TCG streamers: an OBS overlay with your deck, a !deck command for Twitch chat, short links, deck images and the LIVE badge.
- [Origins TCG at Steam Next Fest 2026: the numbers, ranked and the Crimson Cup](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/steam-next-fest-2026): Origins TCG at Steam Next Fest, 19–26 October 2026: ranked mode, the Crimson Cup won by CoachCrono, the official numbers and the move to Early Access.
- [Roadmap and dates: from the demo to Early Access and 1.0](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/roadmap-and-dates): Every confirmed Origins TCG date, from the first Steam post to the demo, the Crimson Cup and Early Access on 27 October 2026, plus what comes next.
- [Origins TCG ranked: Grandmaster, divisions and the first Early Access season](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/origins-tcg-ranked): Ranked in Origins TCG, in Early Access since 27 October 2026: the Grandmaster Division and its world leaderboard, season 1, rewards and Victory Points.
- [Is Origins TCG pay-to-win? Free-to-compete, explained](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/is-origins-tcg-pay-to-win): Koin Games sells Origins TCG as the first free-to-compete card game with zero pay-to-win. What money actually buys, and the honest caveats.
- [Origins TCG Kickstarter: date, pre-registration, Alpha Edition and what we know](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/origins-tcg-kickstarter): The Origins TCG Kickstarter for the Alpha Edition opened on 27 October 2026: what is in it, the VIP pre-registration, the preorder-only boxes, the dates.
- [Two ways to collect: how the Origins economy works](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/collector-economy): Competitive cards are free. Collector cards are limited, graded and tradeable on Steam. Here is what is confirmed and what is not.
- [Conquest in Origins TCG: how to build three decks that pass the unique-card rule](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/origins-tcg-conquest): How to build a Conquest line-up for Origins TCG: how unique cards are counted, the deck builder check and real community decks that pass the rule.
- [On Reveal Mid Range: how to play the Mulan midrange deck](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/on-reveal-midrange-guide): Game plan, mulligan and round-by-round play for On Reveal Mid Range, the Mulan deck that repeats every On Reveal ability, for ladder, competitive and tournaments.
- [King of Value Trade: how to play the King Arthur midrange deck](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/king-of-value-trade-guide): Game plan, mulligan and round-by-round play for King of Value Trade, the King Arthur midrange deck built to win every trade two cards for one.
- [Dorothy Combo: how to play the move deck after the 21 September patch](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/dorothy-combo-guide): The move deck rebuilt around the 21 September buffs: how Dorothy grows, which combos to look for, the mulligan and what the list still cannot do.
- [The Trick-or-Treat Legion: how to play the Legion of the Dead deck](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/trick-or-treat-legion-guide): The Legion of the Dead list built to be unpredictable: how the Zombie board works, the Golden Egg and Boogeyman combo, the mulligan and the matchups.
- [3 Pigs Mid Range: how to play the Three Not So Little Pigs midrange deck](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/three-pigs-midrange-guide): Game plan, mulligan and round-by-round play for 3 Pigs Mid Range, the midrange deck led by Three Not So Little Pigs, for ladder and competitive.
- [3 Pigs Mid Range: matchups, key interactions and Conquest](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/three-pigs-midrange-matchups): Part two of the 3 Pigs Mid Range guide: the interactions that win games, how to play the main matchups, the mistakes to avoid and Conquest.
- [Healing Healsing: how to play the Van Helsing control deck](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/healing-healsing-guide): Game plan, mulligan and round-by-round play for Healing Healsing, the Van Helsing control deck that heals, draws and resets the board.
- [Healing Healsing: matchups, key interactions and mistakes to avoid](https://originsmeta.com/en/guides/healing-healsing-matchups): Part two of the Healing Healsing guide: the healing and card-draw interactions, the main matchups, the mistakes that lose to aggro, Conquest.

- [Chi scrive qui](https://originsmeta.com/it/authors): le persone che firmano le guide, i mazzi e le news, e di che cosa si occupa ciascuna.
- [Guide della community](https://originsmeta.com/it/guides/community): guide scritte da Autori, Creator e giocatori Pro di OriginsMeta, aggiornate dai loro autori e tradotte dal sito.

- [FAQ](https://originsmeta.com/es/faq): las respuestas que hemos escrito y comprobado, cada una con su fuente y su fecha: fecha de lanzamiento y Acceso anticipado, idiomas, versión móvil, progreso desde la demo, clasificatoria, Legendarias, códigos de mazos, Crimson Cup y Kickstarter.
- [Tier list](https://originsmeta.com/es/tier-list): mazos, Legendarias y cartas base; la clasificación de OriginsMeta, con los resultados de los torneos, está en preparación.
- [Las más jugadas](https://originsmeta.com/es/tier-list/most-played): en cuántos de los mazos publicados en OriginsMeta aparece cada Legendaria y cada carta, con los arquetipos de los mazos. Popularidad, no win rate.
- [Tier list de la comunidad](https://originsmeta.com/es/tier-list/community): la media de las tier lists guardadas por los miembros, con los votos por carta; una vista previa hasta llegar a 5 listas.
- [Crea tu tier list](https://originsmeta.com/es/tier-list/create): tu propia tier list de Origins TCG, arrastrando las cartas del juego a los tiers de S a D, con las Legendarias aparte, para compartirla con un enlace. Gratis, sin cuenta.
- [Tier list de votos a las cartas](https://originsmeta.com/es/tier-list/votes): vota cada carta de Origins TCG del 1 (floja) al 10 (excelente); el promedio de los votos de los miembros crea una tier list de Legendarias y cartas base.
- [MetaShifting](https://originsmeta.com/es/metashifting): las notas del parche de Origins TCG: cada cambio de equilibrio, carta por carta y parche por parche, del más reciente al más antiguo, a partir de las publicaciones oficiales de Koin Games.
- [Lista de cartas](https://originsmeta.com/es/cards): todas las cartas del juego con sus estadísticas actuales, el texto oficial en inglés y en español, como en el juego, el historial de cambios y la leyenda de la que viene cada una.
- [Ubicaciones](https://originsmeta.com/es/locations): las ubicaciones registradas hasta ahora, con su efecto, con búsqueda y filtros.
- [Mazos](https://originsmeta.com/es/decks): las listas publicadas por la comunidad desde el deck builder, cada una con su guía y una valoración de 1 a 5 estrellas.
- [Mazos de torneo](https://originsmeta.com/es/decks/tournament): tríos de mazos Conquest para torneos como la Crimson Cup, publicados por los jugadores con una sola guía: tres Legendarias distintas, códigos del juego y votos.
- [Draft](https://originsmeta.com/es/draft): draft gratis de Origins TCG en tres formatos contra el Cerebro, nuestro bot, o contra un amigo: elige tus cartas, arma 1 Legendaria + 12 y copia el código del juego.
- [Analytics](https://originsmeta.com/es/analytics): el win rate de Origins TCG con las partidas registradas en la app OriginsMeta Tracker: Legendarias, mazos de la comunidad, arquetipos, cartas y enfrentamientos, por parche.
- [Números de la Crimson Cup](https://originsmeta.com/es/analytics/crimson-cup): los números oficiales de la Crimson Cup de Koin Games, clasificatorio a clasificatorio: ban rate de cada Legendaria, mazos entregados, cartas más usadas y el torneo junto al ladder.
- [OriginsMeta Tracker](https://originsmeta.com/es/tracker): nuestra app para Windows que registra sola tus partidas de Origins TCG, sigue tu mazo junto al juego y añade un overlay para streamers; funciona con una cuenta gratuita de OriginsMeta. Guía de instalación paso a paso.
- [Deck builder](https://originsmeta.com/es/deck-builder): construye un mazo legal en el navegador — una Legendaria más doce cartas base distintas con dos copias de cada una, 25 cartas — y luego exporta el código del juego o publica la lista. Gratis, sin cuenta para construir.
- [Guías](https://originsmeta.com/es/guides): cómo funciona el juego, la hoja de ruta, la economía de coleccionismo, cómo empezar a jugar, guías de mazos y matchups.
- [Torneos y eventos](https://originsmeta.com/es/tournaments): eventos oficiales y de la comunidad, más el organizador de torneos de la comunidad.
- [Noticias](https://originsmeta.com/es/news): anuncios oficiales, actualizaciones del juego, eventos y los mazos publicados en el sitio; cada parche tiene además su propio artículo. Cada noticia tiene su propia página firmada, con la fecha, la fuente oficial y las cartas a las que afecta.
- [Quién escribe aquí](https://originsmeta.com/es/authors): las personas que firman las guías, los mazos y las noticias, y de qué se ocupa cada una.
- [Guías de la comunidad](https://originsmeta.com/es/guides/community): guías escritas por los Autores, Creators y jugadores Pro de OriginsMeta, actualizadas por sus autores y traducidas por el sitio.
- [Cómics](https://originsmeta.com/es/news/comics): cómics sobre Origins TCG dibujados por los creadores de la comunidad.
- [Creadores y autores](https://originsmeta.com/es/creators): los creadores, autores y streamers que hacen contenido de Origins TCG, con sus canales e idiomas.
- [Quiénes somos](https://originsmeta.com/es/about): quiénes somos, cómo trabajamos y qué fuentes usamos.

- [Analytics](https://originsmeta.com/fr/analytics): le win rate d'Origins TCG d'après les parties enregistrées avec l'app OriginsMeta Tracker : Légendaires, decks de la communauté, archétypes, cartes et affrontements, patch par patch.

- [OriginsMeta Tracker](https://originsmeta.com/fr/tracker): notre application Windows qui enregistre seule vos parties d'Origins TCG, suit votre deck à côté du jeu et ajoute un overlay pour les streamers ; elle fonctionne avec un compte OriginsMeta gratuit. Guide d'installation pas à pas.
- [Deck builder](https://originsmeta.com/fr/deck-builder): construisez un deck légal dans le navigateur — une Légendaire plus douze cartes de base différentes en deux exemplaires chacune, 25 cartes — puis exportez le code du jeu ou publiez la liste. Gratuit, sans compte pour construire.

- [Tier-List der Kartenbewertungen](https://originsmeta.com/de/tier-list/votes): jede Karte von Origins TCG von 1 (schwach) bis 10 (stark) bewertet; der Durchschnitt der Stimmen der Mitglieder ergibt eine Tier-List der Legendären und Basiskarten.

- [Draft](https://originsmeta.com/de/draft): kostenloser Draft für Origins TCG in drei Formaten gegen das Gehirn, unseren Bot, oder gegen einen Freund: Karten wählen, 1 Legendäre + 12 bauen und den Spielcode kopieren.
- [Analytics](https://originsmeta.com/de/analytics): die Win-Rates von Origins TCG aus den Partien, die mit der App OriginsMeta Tracker aufgezeichnet wurden: Legendäre, Community-Decks, Archetypen, Karten und Matchups, Patch für Patch.

Installationsanleitung Schritt für Schritt.

- [Создать свой тир-лист](https://originsmeta.com/ru/tier-list/create): ваш собственный тир-лист Origins TCG — перетащите карты игры по уровням от S до D, легендарные отдельно, ссылкой можно поделиться. Бесплатно, без аккаунта.
- [Тир-лист по оценкам карт](https://originsmeta.com/ru/tier-list/votes): каждая карта Origins TCG с оценкой от 1 (слабая) до 10 (сильная); среднее по голосам участников даёт тир-лист легендарных и базовых карт.
- [MetaShifting](https://originsmeta.com/ru/metashifting): патчноуты Origins TCG: каждое изменение баланса, карта за картой и патч за патчем, сначала новые, по официальным публикациям Koin Games.
- [Список карт](https://originsmeta.com/ru/cards): все карты игры с актуальными характеристиками, официальным английским текстом, официальным русским текстом из игры, историей изменений и легендой, стоящей за каждой картой.
- [Локации](https://originsmeta.com/ru/locations): локации, известные на сегодня, с их эффектами, с поиском и фильтрами.
- [Колоды](https://originsmeta.com/ru/decks): деклисты, опубликованные сообществом в конструкторе колод, каждый с гайдом и оценкой от 1 до 5 звёзд.
- [Турнирные колоды](https://originsmeta.com/ru/decks/tournament): тройки колод Conquest для турниров вроде Crimson Cup, опубликованные игроками с общим гайдом: три разные легендарные, коды игры и оценки.
- [Драфт](https://originsmeta.com/ru/draft): бесплатный драфт Origins TCG в трёх форматах против Мозга, нашего бота, или против друга: выбирайте карты, соберите 1 легендарную + 12 и скопируйте код игры.
- [Analytics](https://originsmeta.com/ru/analytics): винрейты Origins TCG по партиям, записанным приложением OriginsMeta Tracker: легендарные, колоды сообщества, архетипы, карты и матчапы, патч за патчем.
- [OriginsMeta Tracker](https://originsmeta.com/ru/tracker): наше приложение для Windows, которое само записывает ваши партии в Origins TCG, ведёт трекер колоды рядом с игрой и умеет показывать оверлей для стримеров; работает с бесплатным аккаунтом OriginsMeta. Пошаговая инструкция по установке.
- [Конструктор колод](https://originsmeta.com/ru/deck-builder): соберите корректную колоду в браузере — одна легендарная и двенадцать разных базовых карт по две копии, 25 карт, — затем экспортируйте код игры или опубликуйте список. Бесплатно, для сборки аккаунт не нужен.
- [Гайды](https://originsmeta.com/ru/guides): как устроена игра, дорожная карта, коллекционная экономика, как начать играть, гайды по колодам и матчапам.
- [Турниры и события](https://originsmeta.com/ru/tournaments): официальные события и события сообщества, а также организатор турниров для сообщества.
- [Новости](https://originsmeta.com/ru/news): официальные анонсы, обновления игры, события и колоды, опубликованные на сайте; у каждого патча есть отдельная статья. У каждой новости своя подписанная страница с датой, официальным источником и затронутыми картами.
- [Авторы](https://originsmeta.com/ru/authors): люди, которые подписывают гайды, колоды и новости, и за что отвечает каждый из них.
- [Гайды сообщества](https://originsmeta.com/ru/guides/community): гайды авторов, креаторов и про-игроков OriginsMeta, которые авторы сами поддерживают в актуальном виде, а сайт переводит.
- [Комиксы](https://originsmeta.com/ru/news/comics): комиксы про Origins TCG, нарисованные креаторами сообщества.
- [Креаторы и авторы](https://originsmeta.com/ru/creators): креаторы, авторы и стримеры, которые делают контент про Origins TCG, с их каналами и языками.
- [О нас](https://originsmeta.com/ru/about): кто мы, как работаем и какими источниками пользуемся.

## Feeds, sitemaps and full text

- [Full text (llms-full.txt)](https://originsmeta.com/llms-full.txt): every guide and news article in English as plain Markdown, plus every card in the game's collection with its official English text and, apart, the created cards (not checked in the game). Generated from the site's data at every deploy.
- [News feed (RSS)](https://originsmeta.com/en/news/feed.xml): every news article as it is published; also in Italian (/it/news/feed.xml), Spanish (/es/news/feed.xml), French (/fr/news/feed.xml), Portuguese (/pt/news/feed.xml) and German (/de/news/feed.xml).
- [Sitemap index](https://originsmeta.com/sitemap.xml): one sitemap per section and language.

The German texts on 20 October 2026 too, all before Early Access; the 0.8 patch notes of 27 October 2026 list no card changes.
